Chapter 359 - 359 The Exhibition Begins; Method!

Chapter 359 - 359 The Exhibition Begins; Method!

359 The Exhibition Begins; Method!

Lin Fan had no idea about the misunderstanding between the young man and his father.

He drove the Ferrari 812 through the streets of Lun City.

Some people said that only those in Hua Nation who had not seen the world would be attracted by sports cars.

If it was overseas, a sports car would just be an ordinary means of transportation. No one would even take a second look at it.

In reality?

Lin Fan was driving the Ferrari 812 on the streets of Lun City. Wherever he went, he would attract the attention of many people.

Just like that, Lin Fan went on a short one-day tour of the city.

…

In the blink of an eye, the next day arrived.

Today, Chu Yunyue was wearing a white shirt, black trousers, and a pair of black high heels. She looked very capable.

Under the escort of the Royal Hotel’s private car, Chu Yunyue, Lin Fan, the oval-faced woman, and the staff of Flower Stem arrived at the exhibition center very quickly.

The exhibition center was very lively today.

Even at the door, one could easily smell the fragrance that assailed one’s nostrils, mesmerizing one.

It seemed like it was also because of this that it attracted an endless stream of people that kept surging in.

Many people with different skin colors came to the booths. They either tried out the perfumes, asked about them, or bought them.

Except for Flower Stem.

The sky gradually darkened, but no one came to Flower Stem’s booth.

Chu Yunyue and the employees could not help but feel anxious.

Flower Stem was very popular in Hua Nation.

However, it was not famous overseas.

Therefore, they knew that they would not receive much attention.

Chu Yunyue and the others were mentally prepared.

However, the current situation was far beyond what they had expected.

“My name is Chu Yunyue,” replied Chu Yunyue politely.

Brewer’s eyes lit up when he heard that. He praised, “Your voice is very pleasant. Also, based on your name, you should be from Hua Nation.”

Although Brewer had a plan in his mind, his expression did not change. He continued, “I saw that no one has been visiting your booth. How about it? Do you want to have a drink or two tonight? I’ll tell you some methods.”

Brewer was a staff member of GR Perfume which had a booth diagonally opposite Flower Stem’s booth.

Ever since Chu Yunyue arrived at the booth, Brewer was immediately attracted to her.

Chu Yunyue had the same voluptuous figure as the top beauties of Eagle Country. At the same time, she had exquisite facial features that far surpassed the top beauties of Eagle Country.

In addition, she had a unique exotic temperament.

In Brewer’s eyes, Chu Yunyue was the most perfect woman in the world.

Therefore, whenever he had the time, he would sneak a peek at Chu Yunyue.

When today’s exhibition was about to end, he could not wait to walk over.

Brewer knew that many people from Hua Nation liked foreigners very much.

Now, he had proposed a way to increase the number of customers at the booth.

He believed that Chu Yunyue would definitely agree to his request.

As long as they drank together, he would have a chance!

Brewer was already cheering in his heart.

However…

“That’s alright,” said Chu Yunyue.

Chu Yunyue was not a fool considering how she was able to establish such a huge company.

She could tell what Brewer was thinking at a glance.

Then, Chu Yunyue ignored Brewer and said, “Today’s exhibition is about to end. Everyone, pack your things and get ready to go back and rest.”

Then, she held onto Lin Fan’s arm and walked out together.

Seeing this…

Brewer’s body stiffened slightly, and his face turned ugly.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the morning of the third day.

Although Flower Stem could be said to have suffered a huge setback, Chu Yunyue, the oval-faced woman, and the staff of Flower Stem were still in high spirits.

They were looking forward to the day being different.

However, sometimes things went against one’s wishes.

The entire morning had passed, but no one was interested in Flower Stem.

Brewer took advantage of the lunch break to come to Chu Yunyue again. He said, “Beautiful Ms. Chu, do you really not want more customers at your booth?

“By the way, I forgot to tell you that my uncle is Alan Peter, the director of Eagle Country Oil Company. I think… you should understand that I have the ability to make your booth have more customers, right?

“Why don’t we have lunch together and discuss it properly?”

Brewer noticed that Chu Yunyue already had a boyfriend yesterday.

However, this meant nothing to him.

Not to mention having a boyfriend, even if she was already married… there was no problem with that.

After Brewer finished speaking, he puffed out his chest and made a gesture that he thought was handsome.

He thought that Chu Yunyue would be immediately convinced by his charm after seeing his handsome appearance and hearing that he had an uncle who was the director of Eagle Country Oil Company.

However…

The result was different from what he had expected.

“My boyfriend and I are going out for dinner. Don’t block the way!” Chu Yunyue said.

She was an entrepreneur, but at the same time, she could also be considered a businesswoman.

A businessperson would not easily make enemies with others.

Therefore, even if they hated someone, they had to be tactful and polite on the surface.

As for Chu Yunyue… She did not have any intention of being tactful to Brewer, who was suspected to have a powerful background.

After saying that, Chu Yunyue held Lin Fan’s arm again and walked out.

Seeing this, Brewer’s mouth twitched slightly, and his expression became a little ugly.

Lin Fan had a weird expression on his face as he looked at Brewer. His uncle was the director of Eagle Country Oil Company?

Interesting.

Lin Fan and Chu Yunyue had just finished their lunch. When they returned to the exhibition center, the phone in his pocket rang.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was an unknown number.

Lin Fan did not hesitate and answered the call.

Very quickly, a somewhat dull and awkward-sounding sentence spoken in the Hua Nation language rang out from the other end.

“Hello, Mr. Lin.”

Lin Fan said, “Hello, may I know who you are?”

Then, the earlier voice was replaced by a very clear and pleasant voice.

“Hello, Mr. Lin. I’m the interpreter for the chairman of Eagle Country Oil Company, Jules Grant. The person who just spoke to you is the chairman, Mr. Jules Grant. He asked me to convey his regards to you again.”
